skill.name: review-my-diff
skill.description: Review uncommitted or branch changes before opening a pull request, with prioritized findings backed by file and line evidence.
skill.summary: Inspect Git changes, check surrounding code, and report actionable issues without editing files unless asked.
skill.author: agentkitco

content.user_title: Review Your Git Changes Before a Pull Request
content.value_statement: Unreviewed changes can hide correctness, security, and compatibility problems. This skill guides an evidence-based review with prioritized findings and clearly reported validation results.
actual_capabilities: Inspect staged, unstaged, and branch changes using Git status, diff, and merge-base commands.
Infer change intent and inspect surrounding callers, tests, and configuration.
Check correctness, safety, tests, compatibility, maintainability, and unrelated changes in a defined order.
Run existing project tests, lint, and type checks when quick, and report commands and results.
Organize findings into blockers, recommended fixes, optional nits, positive observations, and questions.
Require file and line evidence for findings and conclude with a reasoned readiness recommendation.
limitations: Requires access to a Git repository and an assistant capable of reading files and running commands.
Does not guarantee complete defect detection or replace human approval.
May skip slow or unavailable checks and must disclose checks that were not run.
Does not provide command isolation; project checks can execute repository code and have side effects.

use_cases.title: Check Local Changes
use_cases.description: Review staged and unstaged edits for concrete defects before preparing a pull request.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Branch for Review
use_cases.description: Compare a feature branch with its base and identify compatibility risks, missing tests, and unrelated changes.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Review Findings
use_cases.description: Separate merge blockers from optional cleanup and document verification gaps before requesting human review.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Local Edits
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my staged and unstaged changes. Report concrete issues with file and line evidence, and do not edit files.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: inspect local changes before committing.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Feature Branch
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this branch against the default branch using the merge base. State the intent, rank findings, and finish with a readiness recommendation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare a branch for a pull request.

prompt_templates.title: Check Risky Behavior and Tests
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my diff for input validation, authorization, error handling, and missing tests. Run quick existing checks and distinguish verified issues from suspicions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: examine security-sensitive or error-prone changes.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Large Compatibility Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this branch by directory, tracing risky changes through callers, configuration, migrations, and tests. Report coverage gaps, verification limits, and merge blockers without editing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: inspect a large change spanning multiple components.

output_examples.input: Review a change that suppresses save errors and reports success.
output: Checks run: none; the project checks were not available.
Blocker: the error path reports success after a failed save, misleading callers. Preserve failure propagation.
Questions for the author: should callers retry failed saves?
Recommendation: ready after fixes because save failures must remain observable.

output_examples.input: Review a small refactor with passing checks and no traced defects.
output: Intent: remove duplicate validation while preserving behavior.
Checks run: existing tests, lint, and type checks passed.
Looks good: validation behavior is covered by existing tests.
Recommendation: ready for human review based on the inspected changes and completed checks.

best_practices: Specify the intended behavior and comparison branch before starting the review.
Run project checks only in a trusted environment with appropriate permissions.
Require file and line evidence, consequences, and clear disclosure of unverified checks.
anti_patterns: Treating a readiness recommendation as approval to merge.
Requesting vague style criticism without concrete evidence.
Executing checks from an untrusted repository with unrestricted credentials or permissions.

faq.question: Which changes can this skill review?
faq.answer: It covers staged changes, unstaged changes, and branch differences calculated from a merge base.

faq.question: Will it edit my files?
faq.answer: The instructions prohibit editing files unless requested. Project checks can still create artifacts or other side effects.

faq.question: Does it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: It asks the assistant to run existing tests, lint, and type checks when quick, and disclose skipped checks.

faq.question: How are findings prioritized?
faq.answer: The report separates blockers, recommended fixes, and optional nits, with positive observations and questions for the author.

faq.question: Can it handle a large diff?
faq.answer: It instructs the assistant to review large diffs by directory and disclose that approach.

faq.question: Does a ready recommendation approve my pull request?
faq.answer: No. The skill explicitly prohibits approval and provides a readiness recommendation with supporting reasons.
